The materials from the 2025 modeling workshop in Brisbane, Australia are saved in this repository for use by participants of the eASIA JRP collaboration.

The material is separated by day. Within each day's folder, work from the first file to the last if you wish to follow the order of the workshop.

If you have any questions, please e-mail Rachel Mercaldo.
